dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Will the Fontaine Research Institute take you back?

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: If I were Raimondo, I wouldn't let Edwin Eastinghouse himself be idle and outside the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: Otherwise... Hmph! Does he really want the Institute to turn into a Fonta development factory?

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: But now that that Choiseul has moved his office into the Institute... He might try to stop me from returning...

dialogues.speaker: Edwin Eastinghouse
dialogues.text: I just want to conduct my own research in peace. Is that too much to ask?
